notes: The workshop table must support mixed crochet and knitting sessions.
The supplier needs per-model file records and a short note about any manual review items.
Each slot should map to one selected model only.

slots.goal: Keep one active skein or cake controlled at the table during instruction.
must_have: usable with a single active yarn feed

slots.goal: Provide a marker that stays secure in storage pouches between classes.
must_have: closable or fully enclosed marker form

slots.goal: Hold both crochet hooks and knitting needles at the shared tool table.
must_have: more than one printable part is acceptable

manual_checks_template: Confirm nozzle size and material choice with the supplier.
Confirm color preference for shared classroom sets.
Confirm whether any model should be scaled before print preparation.
